Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List
EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. Plan for 200 to 300+ hours: finish the story first, then the stranger strands, then activities and collectibles, and save the 100% Completion cleanup for last — most of the list falls out of that order naturally.
trophies.source: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Gone Fishing is Jason's first mission — play through it and the trophy pops when the mission ends.
trophies.source: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and it pops at the chapter's end.
trophies.source: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish every mission in Chapter 2 and it pops at the chapter's end.
trophies.source: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish every mission in Chapter 3 and it pops at the chapter's end.
trophies.source: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish every mission in Chapter 4 and it pops at the chapter's end.
trophies.source: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Beat the final mission and it pops at the credits. After this, Leonida opens up for free roam and the 100% Completion Checklist unlocks — that is when the real cleanup begins.
trophies.source: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the Breakfast Run mission as the story presents it.
trophies.source: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete The Cartel Heist mission as the story presents it.
trophies.source: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the Child's Play mission as the story presents it.
trophies.source: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the Headliners mission as the story presents it.
trophies.source: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the VCIA Takedown mission as the story presents it.
trophies.source: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the Operation Savage Glory mission as the story presents it.
trophies.source: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy on the list. The 100% Completion Checklist unlocks after the story — check it at Touch Pad > Progress > 100% Completion. You do not need literally everything (for example 15 of the 18 Collectible Card sets and 70 of the 80 Challenges), but you need almost everything, so treat it as the final cleanup phase after the story, the stranger strands and the big activity grinds.
trophies.source: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: There are 397 stunts in Leonida, so you need just over half: 130 Stunt Jumps (ramps, bridges, construction sites), 202 Under the Bridges (fly aircraft under bridges), 40 Knife Flights (fly sideways through gaps between tall buildings) and 25 Base Jumps (leap off peaks and tall buildings through checkpoints). Find them at Touch Pad > Exploration > Stunt Spots and track progress at Touch Pad > Progress > Activities > Stunts. Stunt Jumps have their own extra challenges you do not need for this trophy.
trophies.source: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: There are 9 activity types in Leonida. Try one of each — a race, a shooting range challenge, a drone race, fishing, an arcade game, and so on — and the trophy pops. Easiest done early by sampling whatever activity markers you pass.
trophies.source: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the two ranges: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero. Find them at Touch Pad > Activities > Shooting Ranges. Most challenges have three difficulty tiers to clear, and some stay locked until you meet their conditions — check the map for what each one needs. Track progress at Touch Pad > Activities > Shooting Ranges.
trophies.source: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations. Some charge an entry fee, so keep cash on hand. See every location at Touch Pad > Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones and work through them one by one.
trophies.source: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 DIFFERENT races — winning the same race twenty times does not count. Race locations appear all over Leonida as you explore; track them at Touch Pad > Activities > Racing. Most locations let you hire a car, but if you bring your own, watch its Rating and buy upgrades at Mod Shops first.
trophies.source: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Fairly early in the game Cal asks you to catch a Parrotfish over 2kg. Take a boat with a fishing rod to the area marked on your map — there are plenty of boats around to hijack if you do not own one — and fish there until you land a fish over the weight. Beat Cal's challenge and the trophy pops.
trophies.source: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Find any arcade machine in Leonida, play one arcade game through to the end, and the trophy pops. Arcades are scattered around Vice City — check the map for activity markers.
trophies.source: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Andy's stranger strand. The strand opens when you meet Andy out in Leonida — keep following his missions until the final one ends and the trophy pops.
trophies.source: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Kenton's stranger strand. His final mission is called Maritime Disputes — complete it and the trophy pops.
trophies.source: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Billy's stranger strand. His final mission is called Hometown Heroes — complete it and the trophy pops.
trophies.source: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and the rest — across Leonida. Stranger markers appear on the map as you explore; work through each strand to its final mission. This is the long version of the individual stranger trophies, so it lands naturally if you finish them all.
trophies.source: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Randy's stranger strand, including his Wish List vehicle deliveries — track the vehicle locations as you go. Complete his final mission and the trophy pops.
trophies.source: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Tyrone's stranger strand, including the Kitty Litter Lab locations his missions send you to. Complete his final mission and the trophy pops.
trophies.source: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONLY POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY — do this early. There are 18 meditation spots across Leonida. A meditation only counts once the final zen animation has played, so wait it out at each spot. Track them at Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations and find them at Touch Pad > Exploration > Meditate Around Leonida. One spot is at Jason's house in Chapter 1, so meditate there before the story moves on.
trophies.source: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Part of Bret's stranger strand. Follow his missions until he sends you after a unique animal — track it, take the shot, and bring the hunt home to pop the trophy.
trophies.source: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: There are 18 Collectible Card sets hidden around Leonida. Complete any 3 full sets — cards you have already collected can be sold at Pawn Shops and still count toward your progress. Track sets at Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards. Note that 100% Completion needs 15 sets, so you will keep collecting long after this one pops.
trophies.source: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK is an app on Jason's or Lucia's smartphone (hold Up to open it). Scan landmarks with it to reveal extra information: 31 WAiNK Landmarks, 35 Curiosities and 23 Sculptures are out there, plus No Flusher Tags. You need 100 successful scans in total. Track progress at Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations.
trophies.source: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Challenges are in-game feats of skill — there are 80 in total and you need 50 of them. (100% Completion needs 70, so keep going after this pops.) See every challenge and its requirement at Touch Pad > Progress > Challenges and knock out the easy ones first.
trophies.source: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside you, build up a 4-star Wanted Level, then break line of sight and get out of the search area without being spotted until the heat dies down. A fast car and a quiet hiding spot make this much easier than fighting it out.
trophies.source: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without ever losing your Wanted Level between them. Plan a route through three nearby shops first, keep a getaway vehicle parked outside each one, and move fast — the streak breaks the moment the Wanted Level drops.
trophies.source: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: You discover a vehicle by getting inside it or by scanning it. 100 different vehicles should come naturally over a full story playthrough — every new car, bike, boat and aircraft you climb into counts. Track what you have found at Touch Pad > Progress > Vehicles.
trophies.source: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Group at least 5 enemies together first — a shootout with a crowd works best — then trigger one use of Combat Focus and drop all five before it ends. Do not waste it on one or two stragglers; wait until the group is bunched up.
trophies.source: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Head to Vice City International Airport, get yourself a plane on the tarmac, and take off on your own schedule — no clearance, no flight plan. Expect the airport to notice, so be ready to leave in a hurry.
trophies.source: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get behind the controls of a Rhino tank. Tanks draw heavy attention the moment you roll one out, so plan your route and enjoy the chaos — surviving the heat in a Rhino is the whole point.
trophies.source: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Pick a jewelry store and go in quiet — avoid the cameras and the guards, do not raise the alarm, and get out clean with the goods. If anyone spots you, the attempt is blown: leave and try again another day.
trophies.source: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape cleanly after each one. Vaults are the big jobs — plan the approach, bring the right crew and getaway, and do not linger once the vault is open. Each successful escape counts toward the five.
trophies.source: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Stop an armored truck, crack it open, take the cash and get away before the response arrives. Block the road ahead of it, hit it fast, and have your escape route planned before you start — the truck will not wait around.
trophies.source: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Visit every named region of Leonida — Vice City, the Keys, the swamps, the farmland and everything between. Check your map for areas you have never set foot in and drive through them; the trophy pops once the whole state is covered.
trophies.source: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Every gang in Leonida runs an illegal operation somewhere on the map. Find one operation per gang, rob each of them, and the trophy pops once you have hit them all. Gang territory markers and stranger tips point you at the right spots.
trophies.source: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Head to Ocean Beach, find a beachfront bar with a view of the water, and order yourself a cocktail. Sit back, watch the ocean, and the trophy pops — the easiest one on the list.
trophies.source: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Get inside a vehicle showroom, pick a car, and drive it straight out through the glass front in classic GTA style. The showroom will not thank you — but the trophy will pop.
trophies.source: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl a full game. Follow through on every frame — finish the game and the trophy pops.
trophies.source: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Tied to the partnership strand — the duo activities you do together. Play through the partner content and build the partnership up; this one pops when the partnership hits its peak.
trophies.source: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 Criminal Profile actions. Your Criminal Profile grows with the crimes you commit — robberies, heists, getaways and general mayhem all feed it. Keep playing the criminal life and the count climbs; check your profile progress as you go.
trophies.source: GTAScoop — GTA 6 Trophies & Achievements

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — this one is about a beat that takes two tries. If something fails the first time around, go back and try it again; the trophy pops on the successful second attempt.
trophies.source: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: A hidden encounter out in Leonida — one of those moments that makes you stop and ask what just happened. Explore the stranger corners of the map, especially the places that feel out of place, and this one finds you.
trophies.source: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Score a strike the GTA way: a melee drive-by at the bowling alley. Drive past and swing a melee weapon through the pins (and anyone standing near them) — bowl them all over in one pass.
trophies.source: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked Bills come from heists and big robberies — dirty money you cannot spend directly. Launder them through your contacts, $250,000 in total, and the trophy pops. Keep running heists and laundering the take as you go; it adds up over a full playthrough.
trophies.source: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across Leonida's shops — clothes, weapons, food, whatever you like. Find shops on the map at Touch Pad > Style. It adds up fast once you start buying cars, upgrades and outfits, so do not force it early.
trophies.source: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garages for $160,000 total through the Vice City Real Estate app on your smartphone: Mitchel Auto Center $4,000, 7th Avenue Garage $12,000, Vela Rota Drive Garage $24,000, Persistence Road Garage $7,600, Wyatt Motors $21,600, Bonita Court Garage $34,000, Atlantic Court Garage $40,000, Store n' Bolt $16,800. Each adds one parking spot for vehicles registered at a Pay 'N' Spray or Mod Shop — and those spots feed the On the Spot trophy too.
trophies.source: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 different vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — Scooter Bros delivers your repaired vehicles to your location for a small fee. Register any vehicle you are driving at a Pay 'N' Spray or Mod Shop, as long as you have an empty parking spot (buy garages from the Vice City Real Estate app for more). Ten registrations and the trophy pops.
trophies.source: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
